#en: However, we were attacked and overwhelmed by pirates, my ship badly was damaged... Torin asked me to free him, I did, and somehow he got us to his ship.
zh: 然而，我们遭海盗袭击并被压制，我的船严重受损……托林让我放了他，我照做了，不知怎么他带我们到了他的船上。

#en: For a time, I just jumped from port to port, never staying anywhere for too long. That is, until I heard of a derelict starstation off the beaten track.
zh: 有一段时间，我只是从一个港口跳到另一个港口，从不久留。直到我听说一座偏僻的废弃星站。

#en: Easy now! There's-- There's no need for such strong language! Let's keep things civil. Ahem. Although, I suppose you've got a good reason to be upset...
zh: 别急！没——没必要说这么重的话！我们文明点。咳咳。不过，我想你有理由生气……

#en: Most things seem to stay the same. Usually it's something small, or subtle that changes. Like a person's hairstyle, or... their favorite type of Chunks.
zh: 大多数东西似乎都一样。变化的通常是小而微妙的东西。比如一个人的发型，或者……他们最喜欢的块餐口味。

#en: Ships in orbit would fire down whatever was requested. Emergency backup, supplies, or sometimes just a good old airstrike! Or... "orbitstrike", I guess.
zh: 轨道上的飞船会把请求的东西打下来。紧急支援、补给，有时就是一次老式的空袭！或者……该叫「轨道袭」吧。

#en: For people like us, Watchtower like to employ a particular device. A kind of energy weapon. The first blast disables your ship, the second disables you.
zh: 对我们这样的人，瞭望塔喜欢用一种特定装置。一种能量武器。第一发瘫痪你的飞船，第二发瘫痪你。

#en: What can you say about a secretive galaxy-wide organization? Uh. I don't... I dunno. I can offer some information, but a lot of this will be conjecture!
zh: 一个遍布银河的神秘组织，能说什么呢？呃。我不……我不知道。我可以提供些信息，但很多都是推测！

#en: Just a little scuffle with Watchtower. Fight on the ground, fight in space. Oh, and an Array with some data. You'll want Gren's algorithm for that Slate.
zh: 就是跟瞭望塔的小摩擦。地面打一场，太空打一场。哦，还有个阵列，弄到些数据。你那块数据板该用格伦的算法。

#en: One day, a rival gang jumped us. It got ugly, a fight broke out. I got shot in the stomach, acid burns on my face. You know what my so-called "crew" did?
zh: 有一天，一个敌对帮派伏击了我们。事情闹得很丑，打了起来。我腹部中枪，脸上被酸烧伤。你知道我那所谓的「弟兄」做了什么吗？

#en: Absolutely! We can trust her with this. I mean, Watchtower have given her as much trouble as they've given us. She'd be happy to take a job against them.
zh: 当然！这事可以信她。我是说，瞭望塔给她的麻烦不亚于给我们的。她会乐意接一单对付他们的活。

#en: No, no, no, drones are built for close-quarters combat, Y'know -- dogfights. They aren't capable of traveling or transmitting data beyond a solar system.
zh: 不，不，不，无人机是为近距离格斗造的，你知道——缠斗。它们没法跨越星系航行或传输数据。

#en: Hey, good eye! What you're holding there is a "flare". Similar to the ones the UC and Freestar Collective used in the war, just a different manufacturer.
zh: 嘿，好眼力！你手里那玩意儿叫「信号弹」。跟战时联殖和自由星系联盟用过的类似，只是厂商不同。

#en: Oh, nothing too crazy. Fight on the planet with Watchtower, data recovered from a space Array. Speaking of, you should use Gren's algorithm on that Slate.
zh: 哦，没什么大不了的。在行星上跟瞭望塔打了一架，从太空阵列里找回了数据。说到这个，你那块数据板该用格伦的算法跑跑。

#en: After that, tried to do some good for a while. Fell in with one of the medical firms. Would pull folks outta bad situations, patch 'em up if they're hurt.
zh: 之后，我试着做了阵子好事。加入了一家医疗公司。把人从困境里拉出来，受伤就给他们治好。

#en: What I do know, is that certain implants require use of specific areas of the brain. But, these areas are often already in use by innate bodily functions.
zh: 我知道的是，某些植入体需要占用大脑的特定区域。但这些区域往往已被先天身体机能占用。

#en: Long road ahead of us, but I think it was the right call for me to open this place -- to anyone who needs a port in the storm. Hey, and that includes you.
zh: 前路还长，但我想开这个地方是对的——给任何需要避风港的人。嘿，也包括你。

#en: As best as I can tell, the Disruptor can't knock you out -- if your ship still has power. Which is likely why its first shot disables your ship's systems.
zh: 据我判断，只要你的飞船还有电，干扰器就没法把你击倒。这大概就是它第一发先瘫痪你飞船系统的原因。

#en: Pins and needles all over, am I right? Yeah. Nasty thing that, uh, that "beam" of theirs. First blast disables your ship, second disables anyone on board!
zh: 全身发麻，对吧？是啊。他们那道「光束」可真够狠的。第一发瘫痪飞船，第二发瘫痪船上所有人！

#en: I assume Torin has explained Skydrops. You should install this one into a ship at your earliest convenience. I hope you take as good a care of it as Torin.
zh: 我想托林解释过空投了。你尽快把它装到一艘船上。希望你对它的照看能像托林一样好。

#en: They called them "Skydrops", right? Very versatile, very useful! And now, very illegal to use, thanks to the Armistice. At least, illegal for the military.
zh: 他们管这叫「空投」，对吧？非常通用，非常有用！而现在，因为停战协议，使用它们非常非法。至少对军队是非法的。

#en: Basically, troops planetside would toss down a "flare", like the one I just gave you. It would mark a spot, and then depending on what the flare signaled...
zh: 基本上，行星表面的部队会扔下一个「信号弹」，就像我刚给你的那个。它会标记一个位置，然后根据信号弹标示的内容……

#en: Heh. Eh, don't mind me, I'm just being a jerk. Um... as hard as I'm sure you worked for your position, I think Watchtower's ambitions lie outside of Ryujin.
zh: 嘿。呃，别理我，我只是在犯浑。呃……我确信你为自己的位置付出了很多，但我认为瞭望塔的野心不在龙神集团之内。

#en: Anyway, eventually all the rules and regs became too much for me, so I took what credits I earned, bought myself a junker, and just... set a course wherever.
zh: 总之，最后那些规章我实在受不了，就带上挣到的钱，买了一艘破船，然后……随便定了条航线。

#en: ...mmm, ah, there it is. I see our facility! Near one of the poles. Huh... Gren wasn't kidding, most of it's buried under ice. Won't be easy to get inside...
zh: ……嗯，啊，就是那儿。我看到我们的设施了！在一极附近。哦……格伦没开玩笑，它大部分埋在冰下。想进去不容易……

#en: The group that attacked you, they're called "Watchtower". Not surprised if you've never heard of them. To say they're clandestine would be an understatement.
zh: 袭击你的那伙人叫「瞭望塔」。你没听说过也不奇怪。说他们隐秘都是轻描淡写。

#en: Still, though work keeps me busy, I visit when I can. My brother still lives there, picking up bounty work. Although, truth be told, he's not very good at it.
zh: 不过，虽然工作让我忙，我还是能去就去。我弟弟还住在那儿，接悬赏的活。不过说实话，他干得不怎么样。

#en: I'll monitor for any such signals, and send a team to bring the ship back here, so I can scrap it. I'll keep hold of any useful components, and sell the rest.
zh: 我会监控这类信号，派人把船带回来给我拆解。有用的部件我留着，其余卖掉。

#en: ...Maybe they figured it's smarter to keep an eye on you, nab you at a more "opportune" moment. Hm... It wouldn't be difficult for 'em. Perhaps you noticed...
zh: ……也许他们觉得盯着你更聪明，在更「合适」的时机抓你。嗯……这对他们不难。也许你已经注意到了……

#en: Well, then I suppose you're lucky it's taken this long to consider you a threat worth capturing. And once that happens, there's little you can do to stop them.
zh: 那么，我想你还算走运，他们花了这么久才把你当成值得抓捕的威胁。而一旦如此，你几乎无力阻止他们。

#en: Utilizing technology I don't quite understand... this Skydrop momentarily reanimates the recently dead, sending them into a frenzy, attacking anything in sight.
zh: 利用我不太懂的技术……这种空投会短暂复活刚死去的人，让他们陷入狂热，攻击视野内的一切。

#en: They operate carefully, quietly, and with so much plausible deniability -- that even if someone found out about their existence, it could easily be disregarded.
zh: 他们行事谨慎、低调，还有充足的合理推诿空间——就算有人发现他们的存在，也很容易被忽视。

#en: And after a slightly rocky start, we just kinda started helpin' each other! At first, I thought, "What's the catch?" People don't offer help for almost nothin'.
zh: 在一个不太顺的开头之后，我们就开始互相帮忙了！一开始我想，「有什么条件？」人们不会几乎无条件地帮忙。

#en: Oh and, heh, here's the worst part! There is NO foolproof counter to the Disruptor! Hah! None at all! Believe me, I've looked, I've tried. Heh. There is nothing.
zh: 哦，还有，嘿，最糟的是！干扰器根本没有任何万全的反制手段！哈！完全没有！相信我，我找过，试过。嘿。什么都没有。

#en: I assume Torin has explained Skydrops. You should install this one to a ship of yours. I've the feeling you will make for a better custodian for it -- than Torin.
zh: 我想托林解释过空投了。你该把它装到你的某艘船上。我感觉你会比托林更会照看它。

#en: Sure did. Compared to Torin and Gren, I don't have much of an axe to grind with Watchtower. But from the little I know of 'em, I don't think I like 'em very much!
zh: 确实。比起托林和格伦，我跟瞭望塔没什么大仇。但就我了解的那点来看，我不太喜欢他们！

#en: Uh-huh, you don't say. Well, I'd love to continue this enthralling dialogue we've got going on, catch up on old times, but clock's ticking -- so listen carefully!
zh: 嗯哼，真的吗。嗯，我很想继续我们这番精彩的对话，叙叙旧，但时间不等人——所以仔细听！

#en: I don't know why, but I decided to plant my flag, start fixing the station up bit by bit. And now? Now it's freedom, safety, even home. Guess that's what I needed.
zh: 我不知道为什么，但我决定插上自己的旗子，一点点把这空间站修起来。而现在？现在这里是自由、安全，甚至是家。我想这正是我需要的。

#en: Clearly, Watchtower is still a threat. I know we dealt with them before, but now we're back to square one, so we're gonna need more than two ships to keep us safe.
zh: 显然，瞭望塔仍是威胁。我知道我们以前处理过他们，但现在又回到了起点，所以我们需要不止两艘船来保命。

#en: Okay. A while back, I got my hands on a Watchtower database. Your name showed up, a lot. Most of the information was encrypted, but there seemed to be a lot of it...
zh: 好。前阵子我搞到了一份瞭望塔数据库。你的名字出现了很多次。大部分信息都加密了，但似乎量很大……

#en: So, let's get started on the rest of it, huh? Gren and Harper are on the station. Let's go make the introductions. And remember, this is their first time meeting you!
zh: 那么，我们接着做剩下的事吧？格伦和哈珀在站里。我们去互相介绍一下。记住，这是他们第一次见你！

#en: Still, that's got me wonderin'. How'd Watchtower have a fleet prepped to ambush you like that? They must've been watchin' those Listening Posts real close. But why...?
zh: 不过，这让我纳闷。瞭望塔怎么会备好一支舰队那样伏击你？他们肯定盯那些监听哨盯得很紧。但为什么……？

#en: You'll never believe it. United Transport added Stardock to their official trade routes! Cargo ships are docking here now! Weird seeing 'em treat us like a real station...
zh: 你绝对想不到。联合运输把星坞加入了他们的官方贸易航线！现在有货船在这儿靠港了！看他们把我们当正规空间站对待，还真奇怪……

#en: *chuckle* But we're not military. I got a Skydrop system rigged up to my ship. And that's what we're going to use to get into that facility, and grab the hardware we need.
zh: *轻笑* 但我们不是军队。我在自己的船上装了空投系统。我们就要用它进入那座设施，拿到我们需要的硬件。

#en: Our motto used to be "Care without compromise." Pfft. But thanks to dwindling finances and ever increasing bending of the rules, we had to drop that motto a few years back.
zh: 我们过去的座右铭是「关怀不妥协」。噗。但因为资金减少、规则越来越松动，几年前我们不得不放弃那句座右铭。

#en: Here's a flare! Same plan as last time. Blast a hole in the facility, and when that mech comes out, I'm gonna kamikaze the Perseverance right on top of it. Boom! No more mech.
zh: 给你信号弹！跟上次一样。在设施上炸个洞，等那台机甲出来，我就开着坚毅号直接撞上去。轰！机甲没了。

#en: You know, this place, it's become more than I could've hoped for! Stardock's not just a home for me, it's somewhere people can be free and safe. And that makes it all worthwhile.
zh: 你知道，这地方变得比我期望的还好！星坞不只是我的家，它是一个人们能自由安全的地方。这让一切都值得。
